clue.text: Frank takes a note from examinee

parts.note: frank means candid, open and honest
the letter A is given as written
te is the seventh note of the sol-fa scale (also spelt ti)

explanation.surface: An outspoken person receives a letter from someone sitting an exam.
explanation.walkthrough: 'takes' is only a joining word here.
explanation.definitionFit: A candidate is a person sitting a test or examination.

clue.text: Feature in commercial after retirement

annotationWithheld.why: Clue as held, 'Feature in commercial after retirement', gives AD round BE for ABED only if 'Feature' means BE, which it does not; likely OCR garble of the word giving BE, not found by search.

clue.text: Reject society doctor getting work away from home

parts.note: op is short for opus, a musical work
someone not at home is out

explanation.surface: A fashionable society physician turns their back and takes a job elsewhere.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Reject society' looks like a noun phrase describing an outcast, but it is a verb phrase defining the answer: to drop out is to opt out of conventional life.
explanation.definitionFit: To drop out is to withdraw from conventional life and its expectations, turning one's back on mainstream society.

clue.text: Expert upset incompetent worker

indicators.note: in a down clue, upset turns the word for incompetent upside down so it reads from bottom to top

parts.note: incompetent means bad at something
a hand is a manual worker, as in farmhand

explanation.surface: A skilled person is annoyed at a useless employee.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' looks like an emotion but turns BAD upwards into DAB in this down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: A dab hand is a British idiom for someone very skilful at a particular task.

clue.text: Commotion is the aim of the practical man

definitions.text: the aim of the practical man
definitions.meaning: a practical person wants simply to get things done

explanation.surface: A fuss is what the hands-on man is after.
explanation.definitionFit: A to-do is a fuss or bustle, and a practical man's purpose is getting tasks done, ticking off his list of jobs.

clue.text: Insignificant seismological vibrations

definitions.meaning: read literally, minor earth tremors that are not big quakes

explanation.surface: Earthquake tremors are dismissed as trivial.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means mediocre or unremarkable, and taken literally it describes tremors that are only small rumbles of the earth.

clue.text: Giving birth behind bars

definitions.meaning: the period of labour and delivery, old-fashioned term

explanation.surface: A woman goes into labour while in jail.
explanation.definitionFit: Confinement is the dated term for childbirth and lying-in, and it also means imprisonment, so the phrase covers both senses.

clue.text: Reach the wrong conclusion and be ruined

definitions.meaning: read literally, arrive at an unhappy ending

explanation.surface: Someone draws a false inference and is undone by it.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means to finish up in disgrace or disaster, and literally describes arriving at a poor ending.

clue.text: It charges extortionately for cutting roast meat

parts.note: to clip is to cut or trim
a joint is a large cut of meat for roasting

explanation.surface: A butcher's charge is very steep for carving the Sunday roast.
explanation.definitionFit: A clip joint is a nightclub or bar that overcharges or swindles its customers.

clue.text: Divided into four and given accommodation

explanation.surface: Something is split four ways and also housed.
explanation.definitionFit: To quarter is both to cut into fourths and to billet troops, giving them lodgings.

clue.text: Flier has a frolic

definitions.meaning: a bit of fun, a prank

explanation.surface: A pilot enjoys some playful fun.
explanation.definitionFit: The skylark is a songbird, and a lark is also a spree or piece of mischief.

clue.text: Criticised for attempt to make lace

parts.note: a go is a try or attempt
to tat is to make tatting, a knotted lace

explanation.surface: Someone was disparaged for trying their hand at lacemaking.
explanation.walkthrough: To tat is to make lace by knotting thread with a shuttle.
explanation.definitionFit: Being got at is British slang for being nagged or picked on unfairly.

clue.text: Risotto furthermore contains bean curd

indicators.note: contains signals that the answer sits inside the run of letters in risotto furthermore

explanation.surface: A rice dish that also includes soya.
explanation.definitionFit: Tofu is a soft food made from curdled soya milk pressed into blocks.

clue.text: Saw a daughter get on

parts.note: d is the abbreviation for daughter in genealogies
to get on in years is to age

explanation.surface: Someone noticed their girl growing older.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Saw' looks like the past tense of see, but it is a noun: an old saying.
explanation.definitionFit: A saw is a traditional proverb or maxim.

clue.text: Trouble caused by a small number in New York

indicators.note: in signals that the abbreviation for number goes inside the city's initials

parts.note: no is the abbreviation for number, here a short one

explanation.surface: A handful of people cause difficulties in the big city.
explanation.definitionFit: To trouble someone is to irritate or bother them.

clue.text: Mine receives praise and keen approval

indicators.note: receives signals that the word for mine takes the word for praise into its middle

parts.note: a pit is a coal mine
to laud is to praise

explanation.surface: A colliery is honoured with enthusiastic acclaim.
explanation.definitionFit: A plaudit is an expression of enthusiastic praise or applause.

clue.text: Killed and was convicted

definitions.meaning: as in a thief was nabbed for burglary

explanation.surface: Someone was slain and found guilty.
explanation.definitionFit: Done for means doomed or dead, and being done for a crime is British slang for being convicted of it.

clue.text: Love things to be in order when first viewed

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, which looks like O

indicators.note: in order signals that the letters of things are to be put into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: Lovers want everything tidy at first glance.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting on sight means doing so immediately, at first glance.

clue.text: Daren't arrange to upgrade the car

indicators.note: arrange signals that the letters given are to be reordered

parts.note: the letters of daren't, with the missing I the setter evidently intended, form the anagram fodder

explanation.surface: Someone is afraid to organise replacing their vehicle.
explanation.walkthrough: The fodder as held lacks an I; the setter presumably meant something like 'Daren't I'.
explanation.definitionFit: To trade in a car is to hand it over as part payment for a newer model.

clue.text: Have to get in French cheese for a young guide

indicators.note: to get in signals that the word for have goes inside the cheese

parts.note: brie is a soft French cheese
to own is to have

explanation.surface: Someone must buy some Brie for a junior Girl Guide.
explanation.walkthrough: A Brownie is a member of the junior branch of the Girl Guides (Girl Scouts in the US).
explanation.definitionFit: Brownies are the youngest section of the Girl Guide movement.

clue.text: Robber keeps equipment within the group

indicators.note: within signals that the word for equipment sits inside the word for group

parts.note: a band is a group
rig is equipment or gear

explanation.surface: A thief holds on to the band's gear.
explanation.definitionFit: A brigand is a bandit, especially one in a gang roaming mountains or forests.

clue.text: Mean to be intimate

explanation.surface: Someone intends to get close.
explanation.definitionFit: Near is dated British for miserly, and also means close in relationship.

clue.text: The Spanish can see its influence in their language

parts.note: la is a Spanish word for the
a tin is a can

explanation.surface: Spaniards notice the Roman tongue's influence on their own speech.
explanation.walkthrough: The rest of the clue completes the picture: Spanish descends from the language of Rome.
explanation.definitionFit: Latin is the ancient tongue of Rome, parent of Spanish.

clue.text: He lets me eat a portion of duck

indicators.note: a portion of signals that the answer is a piece taken from the run lets me eat

explanation.surface: A man allows me to have some of his roast duck.
explanation.walkthrough: 'He' is only surface; the definition is 'duck'.
explanation.definitionFit: Smee is an old regional name for certain wild ducks such as the wigeon.

clue.text: Mole makes retired agent frame Israeli leader

indicators.note: frame signals that the turned agent encloses the leading letter
retired means going back, so in this down clue the word for agent reads upwards

parts.note: rep is short for representative, a sales agent

indicators.note: leader signals the first letter of Israeli

explanation.surface: A spy works through a former agent to set up an Israeli chief.
explanation.walkthrough: 'retired' turns REP into PER, which frames I.
explanation.definitionFit: A mole is a stone breakwater or jetty, much like a pier.

clue.text: Bearing north-east up to Michigan

indicators.note: to signals that the reversed letters are attached to the state abbreviation

parts.note: MI is the US postal abbreviation for Michigan

indicators.note: up signals that in this down clue the compass letters read upwards

parts.note: NE is the compass abbreviation for north-east

explanation.surface: A direction pointing north-east towards Michigan.
explanation.definitionFit: Mien is a person's bearing or demeanour.

clue.text: Freedom is necessary in some French debates

indicators.note: in signals that freedom goes inside the French word for some

parts.note: des is French for some
liberation is freedom

explanation.surface: Liberty is essential in certain French discussions.
explanation.definitionFit: Deliberations are careful discussions or debates.

clue.text: A cordial and endearing disposition

indicators.note: disposition signals the letters of endearing put into a fresh arrangement

explanation.surface: Someone has a warm and loving nature.
explanation.walkthrough: 'cordial' looks like an adjective meaning warm, but it is a drink.
explanation.definitionFit: Grenadine is a sweet syrup made from pomegranates, used as a cordial.
